BillHeading.Sponsors: Senate Health & Long Term Care (originally sponsored by Senators Liias, Rivers, Das, Randall, and Wilson, C.)

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to blood donation; and amending RCW 70.01.020.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 70.01.020 and 1969 c 51 s 1 are each amended to read as follows:Donation of blood by person eighteen or over without parental consent authorized.
BillSection.P: (1) Any person of the age of eighteen 18 years or over shall be eligible to donate blood, including donation through apheresis, in any voluntary and noncompensatory blood program without the necessity of obtaining parental permission or authorization.

P.TextRun: (2) Any person between the ages of 16 and 17 years old shall be eligible to donate blood, including donation through apheresis, in any voluntary and noncompensatory blood program after obtaining parental or legal guardian permission or authorization.
